text:
You need a developer who can support SharePoint 2017/2019 solutions, K2 workflows, and the surrounding web and SQL-based integrations without losing sight of deployment, administration, and documentation.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience working across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my recent work has been on modern web applications rather than SharePoint specifically, I’m comfortable moving through complex business systems, understanding requirements, and building reliable features that fit into larger environments.

One project I’d highlight is a booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios. I built a white-label class booking app where each studio got its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. The platform supported multi-tenancy and subscription billing, and it onboarded 64 studios in 6 months. That kind of work required careful data modeling, structured workflows, and integration-minded thinking that translates well to enterprise platforms with multiple moving parts.

Another relevant example is a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics. I built a docs site in 4 languages with instant search, written in MDX by the engineers, and it helped reduce support tickets by 27%. That project reinforced how important clear information architecture, maintainable content structures, and thoughtful user experience are in internal and external systems alike.

Your role calls for someone who can work across functional design, detailed implementation, integration testing, and solution deployment. I’m used to collaborating on requirements, translating them into practical technical decisions, and delivering clean front-end and back-end work. I also understand the importance of stable, maintainable interfaces, which is especially relevant for SharePoint custom solutions, branding, web parts, and integrated workflow-driven systems.

I’d welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your SharePoint and K2 work, and how my full-stack background can support your team’s development and delivery needs.
